'''April 2001 Rochester, Minnesota tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Rochester, Minnesota on 28 April 2001. [[Joshua Grace]] won it. It is known from Justin Alfs's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2171">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-28-moffwicket-goes-to-rochester-4-28-01d2171/ moffwicket-goes-to-rochester-4-28-01], DeckTech (Justin "MoffWicket" Alfs, 28 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-28-moffwicket-goes-to-rochester-4-28-01d2171/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 28 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Rochester, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 24
* '''Winner:''' [[Joshua Grace]]
